decision_needed: Add an issue for third-country workers in Chapter 2?
what_the_files_show: The run record reads Chapter 2 as covering EU and foreign workers, but all 13 Chapter 2 issues were drafted from EU requirements and concern EU workers. 13 items on foreign workers (4 from MKD-IO-2024-001, 9 from MKD-IO-2026-001) fit nothing. They rest on international organisation evidence only, with 2 recommendations.
agent_recommendation: Add one issue, RI-FMW-014, Access and rights of third-country workers, merging the two proposed labels.
what_changes: Adding it brings foreign workers into the analysis on non-EU evidence. Not adding it means the Chapter 2 findings cover EU workers only, which is narrower than the scope as written.

decision_needed: May regional evidence that does not name the country count?
what_the_files_show: The second pass removed 7 items that do not name North Macedonia (MKD-IO-2026-001-0024 to -0029, MKD-IO-2025-001-0004), under a brief written for stage 8, not a rule you set. They include the main foreign-worker recommendations in the ICMPD Roadmap, such as a unique worker identifier. Four more in that source are flagged on the same test (-0001, -0008 to -0010).
agent_recommendation: Restore the 7, marked as regional. Regional evidence can support an issue but cannot alone support a finding about the country.
what_changes: Restoring strengthens the third-country worker evidence but rests on claims not specific to the country. Keeping them out is stricter and leaves that issue very thin. Details to restore are in the second-pass records.

decision_needed: Widen limit LIM-0019 to one more provision of the 2015 law?
what_the_files_show: Art. 5(2) point 1 of MKD-GOV-2015-001 is the only provision naming the EU: it excludes from the quota foreigners given equal treatment under a reciprocity agreement with the EU. It is outside LIM-0019 because it was never amended. A confirmed contradiction turns on this: MKD-EU-2024-001-0058 says the law makes no EU distinction, and MKD-EU-2025-003-0010 says quotas do not apply to EU citizens.
agent_recommendation: Widen LIM-0019 to this provision only.
what_changes: Widening lets RI-FMW-002 explain the contradiction from the legal text. Not widening leaves it reported but unexplained. Scope changes are yours alone.
